data.long_meaning: In the Bible, the name Marc refers to the author of the second gospel. The name is derived from the Greek word ‘Markos’, which means ‘God of War’. Parents who choose Marc usually hope their child will grow to embody god of war and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.name: מרק
in_hebrew.long_meaning: מרק הוא שם שמקורו בשם הרומאי 'מרקוס', שפירושו 'מלחם' או 'לוחם'. השם מרקוס נגזר מהאל הרומי מרקוריוס, שפירושו 'שליח האלים'. השם מרק הופיע לראשונה בברית החדשה כמרקוס, אחד מתלמידי ישוע המשיח. השם מרק נושא משמעות רבה בקרב הנוצרים, שכן הוא מייצג את האומץ והנחישות של מרקוס בהפצת בשורת ישוע המשיח.

in_greek.name: Μάρκος
in_greek.long_meaning: Μάρκος είναι το ελληνικό ισοδύναμο του ονόματος 'Marc', που σημαίνει 'πολεμιστής' ή 'αρχηγός'. Το όνομα Μάρκος προέρχεται από τον ρωμαϊκό θεό του πολέμου, Άρης, και συνδέεται με τον Μάρκος, έναν από τους μαθητές του Ιησού Χριστού. Στην ελληνική παράδοση, το όνομα Μάρκος συμβολίζει το θάρρος και την πίστη στον Θεό.

in_latin.name: Marcus
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Marcus, from which Marc is derived, originates from ancient Rome and is associated with the god of war, Mars. The name Marcus was popular among Roman nobility and was also borne by Marcus the Evangelist, one of Jesus Christ's disciples. In Christian tradition, the name Marc symbolizes courage, strength, and devotion to one's faith.

in_english.name: Marc
in_english.meaning: Marc means 'young warrior' or 'dedicated to Mars'
in_english.long_meaning: The name Marc, derived from Marcus, has its roots in ancient Rome and is associated with the god of war, Mars. Marc, or Marcus in its full form, was the name of one of Jesus Christ's disciples, often referred to as Mark in English. The name Marc symbolizes courage, leadership, and a strong sense of faith. It has been a popular name among Christians due to its biblical significance and association with the early Christian church.

data.cultural_impact: The name Marc has been recorded in history as one of the most popular names of antiquity, particularly in the Roman Empire. data.spiritual_significance: In Christian tradition, the name Marc holds a strong spiritual meaning. Mark is the author of the second gospel in the New Testament. The name Marc serves as a reminder of the power and importance of the Word of God. Additionally, the name’s origins in the Greek word ‘Markos’, which translates to ‘God of War’, symbolizes the spiritual battle that every Christian must face in their daily lives, encouraging courage and resilience in the faith.
